contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (316-340), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, possibly irregular Trier mint issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate mantled left ?holding globe. Obverse inscription; CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description; Globe on altar, three stars above. Reverse inscription: BEAT[A TRAN QVILLITAS]. In exergue: possibly .PTR crescent. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 2.10gms, die axis: 6
